correct_completion: had the team faced such a difficult challenge.
full_sentence: Never before had the team faced such a difficult challenge.
acceptable_variants: had the club faced such a challenge.
had any side faced such a challenge.

options.text: the team faced such a difficult challenge.
options.why_wrong: After a negative adverbial such as 'never before', English requires subject-auxiliary inversion, so the auxiliary must come before the subject.
This is a result clause, not an inverted structure, and it does not follow the negative adverbial in the stem.

options.text: had the team faced such a difficult challenge.
they faced such a difficult challenge before.
options.why_wrong: The adverb is in the wrong position and the subject still comes before the verb, so no inversion occurs.

explanation: After a negative adverbial placed at the start of a clause, English puts the auxiliary verb before the subject. Learners often keep the normal word order here, but the inversion is required in this structure.
translation: Nunca antes a equipe tinha enfrentado um desafio tão difícil.
